items.title: Is DTE Energy (DTE) Priced About Right For Dividend Investors?
items.summary: DTE Energy has delivered a 51.9% total return over the past three years, and with the stock recently closing at US$135.08, the key question for income focused investors is whether that share price still lines up with the dividend stream on offer. Recent deals, regulatory headlines, and a long dividend history all feed into a simple decision for you, which is how much you are prepared to pay today for DTE Energy's future payouts. The 51.9% gain over three years puts real weight on the issue...
